descriptionInUI: Draws every country's real border on the F10 map. A country with no coalition airfield inside it flies a standing air patrol over its own territory from mission start -- visible before you cross, which is the point. Enter and you are warned by radio at once; stay past the engage timer, release a weapon inside the border, or fire on the patrol, and it turns hostile and attacks -- and the field's SAM battery wakes. It orbits as a true neutral and cannot fire until that moment, because a neutral unit in DCS never can. AI intruders are warned but never engaged. Patrol aircraft are free, untracked event content.
